notes: Cats: the Régionale bank's Dessert & Sweet Wines (58 stems) and the 14 sweet stems of Sparkling/Fortified/Sweet; the Village bank's Sweet Wines. Chapters: the Régionale sweet chapter and the Village Sweet Wines chapter. Regions: the homes of the Court's appellations, Sauternes (bordeaux), Vendange Tardive and SGN (alsace), Quarts de Chaume, Bonnezeaux and Vouvray (loire), Tokaji Aszú (tokaj), Recioto di Soave and della Valpolicella (veneto), Vin Santo (tuscany), and mosel as the German Prädikat and Eiswein article; countries germany, austria (Eiswein) and canada (Icewine, Ontario VQA). Grapes: every grape the Court names that the Codex prints: Sémillon, the four Alsace grapes (Muscat Blanc for the Court's Muscat), Chenin Blanc, Furmint, Garganega, Corvina and Cabernet Franc; Trebbiano and Vidal are the Court's but no grape record carries them. Techniques: the four sweet routes of the roster. Service tables: digestifs (Sauternes and the sweet wines, Vin Santo), glassware (Dessert wine, the 60 to 90 ml pour) and temperatures (Sweet whites).
